main_body: open wooden bin with a heap of coal inside, dark interior with a coal mound, brown plank front face
top_band: Tan wood rim at the sides (rows ~6-10) and a thin tan front rim (~row 10). The middle column shows a coal heap and dark interior from rows ~3 to 10, with no distinct back rim.
evidence: The inside of the bin is visible from above as a dark opening with a coal mound, bounded by side rims and a lighter front rim line. Below that is a brown plank front face of about 5 rows with a darker shadow row under the rim. The rim is thin, but the opening reads as a horizontal surface seen from above, so it is a 3/4 container. The front panel is painted flat rather than inset.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown beside the wood, which matches the Beodeul approach. The coal mound has only about 3 tones (black, dark grey, a few grey highlight pixels) and large near-flat dark areas. The front plank face has only 3-4 browns with little grain or per-plank variation. Tiles carry fewer colours than the reference stall and well, which have rich per-material ramps and texture dots. It would look thinner than the references next to them.
